title: Geometry - Lesson 6 Practice: Area Unit Conversion
description: Practice converting between square centimeters and square meters.

questions.question: Which conversion is correct?
questions.explanation: A square meter is 100 cm by 100 cm, so 100 × 100 = 10000 cm².

questions.question: Convert 4 m² to cm². Enter just the number.
Convert 70000 cm² to m². Enter just the number.
To convert square meters to square centimeters, multiply by 10000.
questions.explanation: Each square meter contains 10000 square centimeters.

questions.question: A student converts 2 m² to 200 cm². What is the likely mistake?
options: The student used the length conversion factor instead of the area conversion factor.
The student converted centimeters to meters first.
questions.explanation: Using 100 is correct for length, but area needs 100 × 100 = 10000.

questions.question: Convert 1.5 m² to cm². Enter just the number.
Convert 2500 cm² to m². Enter just the number.
Explain why area conversion from m² to cm² uses 10000, not 100.
questions.correctAnswer: Area has two dimensions. Since 1 m is 100 cm in both length and width, 1 m² is 100 cm × 100 cm = 10000 cm².
questions.explanation: A complete explanation should mention both dimensions and the product 100 × 100.
